I have been farming for many years here in the North Central, and I know that rice needs good food to produce well. I will buy one bag of fertilizer from the agro-dealer in town to spread on this plot because our soils are tired, but I will use the rice seed I kept from my own harvest last season. I do not spray chemicals or water with machines — I wait for the rains, and my family will do most of the work with our hands, though I may hire a few young men for a day or two when the weeding and harvesting are heavy.
